messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service `embeds-eu` (high 5xx rate). Incident ID: PD-84721. Link: https://pd.example/redwood/PD-84721

alex: seeing the flood — lots of duplicate pages from the same alert group, probably cache thrash after the deploy.

maria: acked in PD and jumped on the bridge, taking first pass. :white_check_mark:

kai: quick question — any customer-facing latency/errors yet or just internal 5xx spike?

alex: initial metrics: 1.2% 5xx on embed requests in eu region, error traces point to kvcache evictions + OOM-ish logs on embedder pods. No major user impact yet but risk of escalation.

maria: runbook step 1: scale up embeddings-eu pool x2, step 2: enable prefix-kv cache read-only, step 3: silence duplicate PD alerts for 15m. Doing 1 now.

jordan: if scaling doesn't help we should fallback route to dedicated-embeds-1 (lower perf but stable). Can someone prepare the route change?

alex: preparing route patch. Also propose we suppress noisy duplicates from the alert group — PD is spamming on the same symptom and making responder coordination hard.

maria: silencing duplicates now: `/pd silence --service embeds-eu --id PD-84721 --duration 15m --reason "duplicate flood, mitigation in progress"`

kai: noted. tagging support@ for potential customer notification if we see error rate >2% for 10m.

jordan: taking ownership if maria needs to step off. I'll stay on until error rate <0.5% for 20m.

maria: handing off to jordan in 2m — logging mitigation steps to the bridge. Will follow up in ticket.

alex: patch applied to route (PR: https://git.example/r/redwood/routing/pull/432). Verifying traffic shift.

kai: monitoring dashboards — error rate dropping to 0.6% now, QPS stable. Good sign.

jordan: confirmed. continuing watch. will post status pings every 5m. If anything flares, re-open PD and notify.

incident-bot: PD update: alert suppressed for 15m by maria. Incident remains open under owner: jordan.

alex: thanks all. postmortem checklist: capture deploy hash, kvcache metrics, and whether auto-eviction thresholds need tuning.

maria: adding action items to PD-84721 and assigning to eng-runtime. :memo:

jordan: leaving watch but reachable. ping me @jordan if anything changes.
